name: AM Portal identity and connection management
type: Portal information architecture and authorization contract
requiresDatabases: Tenant membership and connection registry tables

dataIsolation.guard: Portal actions derive person and membership from the server-side session, never from browser-supplied person_id or tenant_id alone.

definitionOfDone: Portal exposes personal identity, LINE binding, tenant workspace and Calendar/Google status pages
Tenant admins can manage members, roles, LINE official account and AI assistant connections, group bindings and Calendar targets
All mutation routes use CSRF protection, role/capability checks and request IDs
Secrets and full external subjects are never displayed
Rental Portal compatibility path is documented and feature-flagged
Unauthorized, inactive and cross-tenant users fail closed
